$comment: Machine-readable Phase 1A scope, distilled from D5 R2 (URS) and D6 R2 (PRD). Agents query THIS, not the PDFs. Statements are compressed to the testable claim; the PDFs remain authoritative for nuance. Regenerate, do not hand-drift.

meta.phaseDescription: Clickable UI/UX prototype for split units on labelled simulated data. Two-week sprint.

roles.opensOn: Is my home comfortable, and what is it costing me?
What do I fix first, and what will I find when I get there?
Same, limited strictly to assigned work.
roles.scope: assigned work orders only — enforced in NAVIGATION, not only in data (D7 §18.2)

roles.opensOn: What needs me today, across the whole fleet?

invariants.rule: Every figure carries Simulated | Estimated | Provisional | Verified, next to the figure itself — never in a page-level disclaimer.
An aggregate inherits the WEAKEST provenance of its inputs. One simulated reading makes the whole total simulated.
Severity always renders colour + shape + label. A bare coloured dot is not acceptable anywhere, including in charts.
Grey means 'we do not know'. A grey unit is never counted as green in a roll-up, and always carries a last-seen timestamp.
invariants.enforcedBy: rollUp() precedence critical > warning > unknown > normal

invariants.rule: Never fabricate a value. Missing is not zero: an absent sensor is stated as absent; an unreported unit is grey, not 0 kWh.
Indoor CO2 ppm and kgCO2e emissions are on SEPARATE cards with distinct labels and distinct icons. Never the same tile group, never a shared axis, never added together.
The word 'credit' is permissible only under Verified provenance. Everything else says 'avoided emissions'. Phase 1A never uses it.
Restriction is a four-step ladder with notice, grace period and dual approval at every step. Never a single switch. 'Stop' is blocked for health-sensitive spaces.
A control is not a toggle that flips. It shows Sent > Acknowledged > Verified, and only Verified settles it into the new position.
A split unit recirculates air. The interface never claims fresh-air control for a split unit alone; the recommendation and the capability are two different components.
Mark the mock as a mock. An unlabelled screen of a trading interface that does not yet exist will be mistaken for one that does.
No user-facing string is hardcoded. Numbers, currency, dates and temperature come from the locale, never string concatenation. EN and ID at launch.
No screen is a dead end — every alert leads to an action, and every severity is clickable.
Role scoping is proven by attempting unauthorised navigation for each role. Third-party technicians see assigned work only.

screens.note: Dark hero: carbon reduced this month. Then comfort per room, then anything red or orange.
Opens on decisions needed and how many carry SLA risk.
Text and voice with visible transcript; text fallback always present.

requirements.statement: Sign in with email or phone and password, lockout after 5 failures, role-based landing.
Sign out for this device and for all devices.
Forgot password with neutral confirmation and time-limited link. MOCKED in 1A.
Language switch on EVERY screen; all strings, templates and formats from locale packs. EN and ID at launch.
Client overview: hero (carbon reduced this month), KPI tiles, room rows with comfort verdict, active alerts, energy sparkline, maintenance timeline.
Technician overview: work queue, priority alerts, route, device health.
Admin/HQ overview: fleet map, critical events, service funnel, payment attention, command activity, energy portfolio, MRV status.
Category and space hierarchy Home|Office > property > floor > room > unit, with worst-status roll-up and search.
Unit detail: current values and freshness, trends, part-level health, controls, carbon card, schedule, history.
Show grey values with last-seen time when data is stale; NEVER fabricate values.
Classify each of the 12 monitored parts across indoor, outdoor and electrical groups as green, orange, red or grey.
Alerts carry evidence (signals, thresholds, duration), confidence, likely cause, impact if ignored, recommended action.
Deliver alerts in-app, push, WhatsApp, email per severity and preference, in the user's language, with delivery status. MOCKED in 1A.
Label predictions SUSPECTED until a technician verdict. Render suspected with a dashed border, not a different colour.
Admin configures thresholds, hysteresis, durations and escalation with a preview of affected units. PREVIEW only in 1A.
Client creates a service request prefilled from an alert or unit, with type, photos, preferred slots and channel.
Admin creates, prioritises and assigns work orders with SLA; auto-creates preventive work orders.
Technician reviews evidence, completes the part-group checklist, records parts and findings, closes or escalates.
Maintenance history, contracts, warranty dates, renewals, upcoming visits; export service reports.
Scope third-party technicians to assigned work orders ONLY.
Change power, mode, setpoint and fan speed with a confirmation showing target, current value and any policy limit; show Sent > Acknowledged > Verified. SIMULATED in 1A.
Weekly schedules with offline fallback.
Client sees balance, due date, payment methods, instructions, notice history and any restriction state. SIMULATED in 1A.
Reminders and overdue notices by WhatsApp and email with a payment link, in the client's language, with delivery recorded. MOCKED in 1A.
Restriction ladder: reminder > minimum setpoint raised > Eco lock and limited hours > off. Each step with notice, grace period, requester plus approver, and audit. SIMULATED in 1A.
Meter power and energy per unit; show watts, kWh today and month, and cost from the tariff. SIMULATED in 1A.

Show normal (adjusted baseline) vs with-solution consumption, the saving in kWh, cost and percentage, AND the method and completeness behind it. The chart is not permitted without a link to the method.
Attribute savings to levers (Eco, setpoint >= 23C, schedule, occupancy, filter cleaning) and show 'how you save' actions.
Display CO2 ppm, humidity, PM2.5 and TVOC where fitted with plain-language bands; STATE WHICH SENSORS ARE MISSING. MOCKED in 1A.
Alert when filters need washing or replacing, from filter-health rules and run hours.
Keep indoor CO2 ppm and kgCO2e emissions on SEPARATE cards with distinct labels.
Scope 2 emissions = kWh x versioned regional grid factor, with source and effective date SHOWN, not hidden.
Avoided emissions from saved kWh x grid factor; label estimated, provisional (completeness < 90%) or verified. MOCKED in 1A.
Corporate sustainability reports by tenant, floor, site and period. SIMPLE REPORT ONLY in 1A.
Carbon platform / registry connection with dual approval and certificates. CLEARLY LABELLED MOCK in 1A.

Detect enclosure opening, movement, cable disconnect and power loss; raise possible-tamper and removal alerts. Tamper has its OWN icon and filter and does not dissolve into the maintenance queue. SIMULATED in 1A.
Manage organisations, users, roles and scopes; invite in the user's language.
Manage tariffs and grid emission factors as versioned tables with effective dates.
Append-only audit of sensitive actions, approvals, deliveries, commands and calculations; export.

monitoredParts.$comment: D6 FR-20. 'Monitor every aspect' is an enumerated list, not a slogan. Each part carries its own health, evidence and recommended action.

openDecisions.question: Who may flag a space as health-sensitive? It blocks the stop step of the ladder.
One or two approvers at each restriction step?
